unit: One bounded public UAF report-version source-integrity/access audit
authority: Current main repository AGENTS.md, WORKFLOW.md, START-HERE.md, research/WORKTREES.md and storage layout; older source protocols are evidence of prior scope, not new authorization.
original_research_checkout: Fresh no-checkout/sparse research worktree prepared from recorded public preservation commit b560f1823b23734f43cc5605a9eaf515a1e0f725, not recreation of the removed Faraday checkout or an edit to a preserved checkout.
question: Do two already preserved March 2020 UAF report paths carry distinct Git LFS hash/size pins and source URL spellings, and what do bounded present HEAD requests establish about those exact URLs?
discovery_disclosure: Prior reports and their hash pins were read before this protocol. This is not a blind or newly designed scientific comparison.

exact_public_requests.purpose: Hash public institutional locator page; retain only report-link labels/URLs, not unrelated personal/contact text.
Status, final URL and allowlisted metadata only; no PDF body.
Status, final URL and allowlisted metadata only; no PDF body.

limits: No bulk dataset/archive requests or retry of closed native-model access routes.
One request per listed resource; bounded timeouts and redirects, no credentials, cookies or access-control bypass.
No source PDF read from a preservation fallback or bulk LFS pull after the operational resolver reported the selected UAF source absent.
No source-document, equation, page, model or rendered-pixel equivalence claim from headers, filenames, lengths or hash pins.
No solver execution, chronology/intent conclusion, historical-cause ranking or legal-record edit.
acceptance: Retain exact old pointer/receipt bytes and provenance; record actual request outcomes; independently check pointer SHA-256 syntax and sizes, and distinguish archived pins, current HTTP metadata and unresolved content equivalence.
publication: Only the new original public-source audit files are eligible for separately named redundant public copies and additive AveLyra publication after identity/privacy/remote verification. No overwrite, deletion, history rewrite or private push.
